## Affected record or file

Include the source identifier or file path.

## Proposed correction

Describe the existing claim and what the evidence supports instead.

## Supporting evidence

Link the original source and give its date and page/record number. Explain whether it is a measured result, a historical report or an interpretation.

## Remaining uncertainty

Keep missing information explicit. Do not post private customer details, credentials or nonpublic operating records.
